settings.review.label: Review before landing
settings.review.body: Where work here is shown to you before it is offered to land: in Daoris's browser at the address where the app normally runs (local), or in a shared environment such as dev, reached by the repository's own documented procedure (deployed). Production is never one. A repository's rule replaces its workspace's whole, and none set anywhere is how work lands today.
settings.review.says.noneSet: None: work is offered to land once its quest is done.
settings.review.says.noneHere: No review environment here, whatever its workspace says: work is offered to land once its quest is done.
settings.review.says.required: Before work here lands, it is shown to you in `{{environment}}` and waits for you to say it is right.
settings.review.says.instead: A task may ask for {{environments}} instead.
settings.review.says.optional: When a task asks for it, work here may be shown to you in {{environments}}; nothing waits for it.
settings.review.says.local: A set-up step here builds the work in its own tree and shows it in Daoris's browser at `{{address}}`; your own servers and processes are not touched.
settings.review.says.run: A set-up step here may run `{{command}}` in its tree on a port nobody holds, without asking you each time; it stops once you have reviewed.
settings.review.says.deployed: A set-up step here follows `{{procedure}}` toward `{{environment}}`; each deploy or write there asks your go-ahead once per ask.
settings.review.says.waiting: Where work here waits for your review, it lands only once you say it is reviewed, `daoris-driver quest review <quest> reviewed`, or skip the review, `daoris-driver quest review <quest> skip`. No set-up step is composed for you yet.
settings.review.required: Wait for my review before landing
settings.review.name: The environment's name for {{name}}
settings.review.procedure: Its procedure in {{name}}, a path in the repository
settings.review.run: A command for a process of its own, for {{name}}
settings.review.saved: {{name}} declares the review environment {{environment}}. Where work there waits for your review, it lands only once you review it or skip the review.
settings.review.savedLacking: {{repositories}} hold no {{procedure}} here: their set-up steps sit until they do.
settings.review.unchecked: {{procedure}} was not looked for: no checkout here to look in.
settings.review.noneSaved: {{name}} has no review environment now, whatever its workspace says.
settings.review.requiredSaved: In {{name}}, work is to wait for your review before it lands.
settings.review.notRequiredSaved: In {{name}}, work no longer waits for your review.
settings.review.cleared: {{name}} takes its review rule from what stands above it again.
